cv:
RAFAEL MORETTI-KLEIN
Principal Software Engineer / Engineering Director
Munich, Germany | rafael.morettiklein@example.com | +49 555 0505 505 | linkedin.com/in/rmk-example

SUMMARY
Engineer and engineering leader with 21 years of experience building large-scale backend systems in Python, Go and C++. Led organisations of up to 45 engineers, defined architecture for platforms serving 50M+ users, and still write code every week, mostly internal tooling in recent years.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Director of Engineering, Platform - Streamhaus GmbH (video streaming), Munich        2019 - 2026 (Aug)
- Led the platform organisation (5 teams, 45 engineers, 5 engineering managers) responsible for identity, playback API, billing integration and developer platform.
- Drove migration from a Python 2 monolith to ~60 Python/Go services on GKE; availability of playback API improved from 99.5% to 99.95%.
- Reduced cloud spend by 31% (EUR 4.2M/year) through rightsizing, committed use discounts and an internal cost dashboard.
- Introduced RFC process, architecture review board and on-call guidelines adopted company-wide.
- Hiring: grew org from 18 to 45 engineers; ran 200+ interviews.

Principal Engineer - Streamhaus GmbH                                                2015 - 2019
- Technical lead for the playback API (Python, Tornado then FastAPI-like internal framework, Cassandra, Redis).
- Designed the entitlement service handling 120k requests/s at peak (Go, Cassandra).
- Co-author of the company's service template and Python style guide.

Senior Software Engineer - Nordfels Telematik AG, Stuttgart                            2010 - 2015
- Backend for fleet telematics: ingestion of GPS data from 300k vehicles (C++ and Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, RabbitMQ).
- Led a team of 6 developers on the route-history product.

Software Engineer - Dataquelle Systems GmbH, Karlsruhe                               2005 - 2010
- C++ and Python for industrial data acquisition software (Linux, embedded x86).
- Built Python test harness used by QA for 8 years.

EDUCATION
Dipl.-Inf. (equivalent MSc) Computer Science, Rhine Valley University, 2005

SKILLS
Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI, Tornado, asyncio), Go, C++ (older), PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Cassandra, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, GCP (GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery), AWS (EC2, S3), Kubernetes, Terraform, gRPC, Protobuf, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems design, architecture reviews, technical hiring, people management

LANGUAGES
German (native), Italian (native), English (fluent)

PUBLICATIONS & TALKS
- "Running Python at 100k rps" - EuroPython-style conference talk, 2018
- "Cost is a feature" - internal platform engineering summit keynote, 2023
cover_letter:
Dear Streamhaus leadership team,

Thank you for the conversations so far about the Director of Engineering, Platform role. I am writing to formally confirm my interest.

Over the past four years as Principal Engineer I have seen the platform from the inside: the entitlement service I designed now handles 120k requests per second, and I led the technical side of the playback API. I believe the next step for the platform is organisational, not only technical. Teams need clear ownership, a lightweight RFC process, and on-call that does not burn people out.

In my first year I would focus on three things: a migration plan for the remaining monolith with clear milestones, a hiring plan to grow the organisation responsibly, and a cost visibility programme so teams understand what their services cost.

I am excited about leading the people I have worked with for years and about building an organisation that keeps engineers close to the code.

With best regards,
Rafael Moretti-Klein
